inputs.sequence_prompt:
A single continuous fifteen-second live-action shot beginning at this EXACT corrected frame. Continue the same flight on the same airship deck. Preserve exactly THREE actors: Locke LEFT, Celes CENTER, ONE Setzer RIGHT at the existing brass lever. Keep faces, hair, proportions, equipment and costumes from the image: Celes ivory dress with blue trim and blonde ponytail, Locke dark open jacket and ivory shirt with blue headband and trousers, Setzer long SILVER-GRAY hair, black coat, blue cuffs, cream trousers. Preserve rigid deck, red-brown wood, brass, ropes, masts, rails and exact controls. No new people, objects, vehicles or deck sections.
COLOR LOCK: match the supplied corrected frame, neutral blue-gray clouds, gray silver hair, natural beige warm skin, ivory cloth. Preserve subdued saturation and stable soft neutral illumination. Do not tint the clouds, silver hair, skin, shadows or highlights violet, purple, pink or magenta. No stylized color grade or colored fill. Blue cloth stays blue, brown wood stays brown-red, brass stays warm. No color drift, exposure pulse, flashing light or glow.
0-5s: The ship is already flying steadily. Setzer looks ahead, makes ONE short deliberate adjustment of the EXISTING lever with his hand already on it, then holds it steady. No new control appears. His body stays right and he remains at his station. Celes notices his movement with a small glance to her right; Locke stays left, relaxed but attentive. Hair and cloth respond to a gentle steady breeze, engine continues without restarting. All three remain grounded in their existing positions.
5-10s: Setzer turns his head partway toward the companions while keeping his torso and hands at the control. He says clearly in natural Brazilian Portuguese, one male voice: <d>[Portuguese] Fiquem atentos ao horizonte.</d> Only Setzer speaks. Celes and Locke listen silently, mouths closed, and react after hearing the instruction. Setzer does not rotate toward the camera or leave his station.
10-15s: Celes gives a small acknowledging nod, then looks forward across the horizon, alert. Locke follows a moment later, shifts his weight onto his planted legs without stepping and scans a different forward sector to the left. Their eye movements and reactions are staggered, not synchronized. Setzer turns his gaze ahead again, keeping the lever steady. Continue soft wind in hair and weighted fabric, steady engine and ongoing flight. No danger or new object appears in the background. End in active attentive watch, no freeze or fade.
Camera stays attached to the deck in the same position and axis as the supplied frame, stable medium-wide three-shot, no push-in, cut, zoom or orbit. Preserve geometry and body separation. No walking, touching another person, rail traversal, extra limbs, duplicates, cloth merging or objects morphing. Native audio only: steady engine, soft wind and Setzer's single Portuguese sentence. No other dialogue, English, subtitles, music, narration or singing.
